tx.Escribo novelas y las comparto con lecto: I write novels and share them with readers all over the country.
tx.Soy escritor y publico con Penguin Rando: I'm a writer and I publish with Penguin Random House. My books reach readers in new editions, such as the second edition of El prisionero del yerbatal and the new edition of Los amantes bajo el Danubio.
tx.Me gusta salir a encontrarme con quienes: I love going out to meet the people who read me: I travel to book fairs across the country, chat on the radio, and share excerpts of what I'm writing.
Thank you to readers all over the country.
